common.tagline: Uncharted jungle moon in the Cademimu sector. Almost nothing is on the public navigation charts.
hyperlanes: Off-lane; only reachable via specialized nav data, not on any commercial chart
common.famousFor: Nothing publicly. The few spacers who've heard the name have heard it whispered.
common.cantinaReputation: If you can find Ajan Kloss in the nav charts, your nav charts are stolen.

localContacts: Captain Skarn — runs the Vanishing Place mercenary garrison on a black contract from Imperial Intelligence. Believes himself a king of his small kingdom.

Mandrake — Separatist Holdout Commando, ex-CIS captain. Refused the shutdown order in 19 BBY; was taken in by the indigenous Klosari after his unit was destroyed and now runs a guerrilla cell with them in the deep canopy.
pointsOfInterest: The Vanishing Place — repurposed pre-Republic temple, Skarn's HQ
Pre-Republic temple ruins (lower vault levels uncatalogued)
Mandrake's wargame hex in the deep south canopy
insider.politicalTensions: Skarn and Mandrake know each other exists; both pretend they do not. A truce of mutual disinterest. Mandrake will help anyone who hurts Skarn; Skarn will pay anyone who solves Mandrake.
smugglerRoutes: No legitimate routes. The known approach corridors all end at the canopy line and avoid Skarn's overflight cone.
insider.whoRunsTheDocks: There are no docks. Skarn's dropship pad doubles as the garrison's only hard surface. Land elsewhere or get shot down.

plotHooks: Admiral Varth was placed at the Vanishing Place specifically because the Empire wanted him to disappear. The breakout is the campaign's inciting event.
Mandrake is an Adv1-recurring NPC — players who help him here may bank a marker for Adv4+.
hiddenTruths: The Vanishing Place's black-site contract is so deep in Imperial Intelligence that even Tarkin's office does not have visibility into it. Skarn's chain of command runs to a single colonel who is now dead.
The temple itself is older than the Republic. The lower vault levels have never been catalogued.

From the outside, Ajan Kloss appears to be an ordinary uncharted jungle moon. The Imperial Intelligence presence here is the campaign's first hidden truth and is not deducible from anything in Common.
secretFactions: Mandrake's Klosari-allied resistance (a Separatist holdout commando cell that went native with the indigenous Klosari)
gm.gmNotes: Run Ajan Kloss as a horror set-piece on the approach (the canopy eats sound) and a heist on the exfil. The escape, not the breakout, is the scene.

campaignNotes.era: 15 BBY — four years since Order 66. Denia has been in stasis here the entire time.
